image_description: A medium shot of a guenon monkey (likely a Blue Monkey or similar species) sitting on a thick, textured branch. The monkey is facing left, with its hands brought up to its mouth as if eating or grooming. It has dark fur on its limbs and back, lighter grayish-brown fur on its torso, and distinctive white markings around the eyes and cheeks. The background consists of blurred vertical branches, indicating an arboreal environment.

Eyes are forward-facing. While resolution limits precise iris color confirmation, they appear dark/brown consistent with the species.
The nose structure is narrow and typical of Old World monkeys.
The ears are largely obscured by the fur ruff and the angle of the head; cannot be definitively judged for size.
